prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 8 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
The person from the photo [Image 1] stands in a full stadium at night, puts both hands behind the ears, puffs out the cheeks, slow push-in, TV broadcast look. A Topo Gigio goal celebration in one vertical 9:16 football clip, filmed like a real TV broadcast camera at pitch level, photorealistic and sharp.

The person celebrating is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), the same build, and the clothes from [Image 1]: their own everyday clothes, never a football kit or a jersey. The person is an adult. The same face from the first frame to the last, so their friends recognize them at once, also in the slow-motion close-ups. Never morph. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the one celebrating is that animal standing upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

The place: a huge covered football stadium packed with fans at night, bright floodlights, a green pitch with white lines, a white goal with a net, plain advertising boards with no words. A few generic adult players in plain dark blue kits with no badges, no numbers and no logos stay far away and out of focus in the background.

0-2 s, in full color: the person jogs away from the goal along the touchline, then walks on in profile with one hand raised to the forehead in a proud salute, chin up, cheeks puffed out.
2-5 s, a cut to high-contrast black and white, in slow motion: a close shot from a low angle in front, from the chest up. The person faces the camera, puts both hands behind the ears with the palms cupped forward, as if asking the crowd to be louder, puffs out the cheeks and pushes the lips forward. The camera slowly pushes in; the face is large and sharp: exactly the face from [Image 1].
5-8 s, still in black and white and slow motion: the person tips the head back and looks up at the roaring stands with a proud, cocky stare, mouth a little open, hands still cupped behind the ears, then lowers one hand while the camera slowly circles around them.

Audio: the roar of a packed stadium crowd that swells when the hands go behind the ears, and one deep drum hit on the cut to black and white. No commentary, no music with words.

Exactly one person celebrates. No score graphic, no scoreboard, no TV channel logo, no flags, no national team or club kits, no crests, no sponsor names, no captions, no watermark. No famous athlete: every player and every fan is a generic adult. Anatomy rules: one head, two arms, two hands with five fingers each; the hands touch the head behind the ears and never merge with the ears, the hair or the face.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 7 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same packed night stadium under floodlights, the same dark stands, the same green pitch and touchline, the same low camera, cuts, timing and moves. The ONLY change: the green ogre in the brown vest and the cream tunic, who salutes on the touchline, cups both hands behind the ears and looks up at the stands, is now the person in [Image 1].

The one who celebrates = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), and the build and clothes from [Image 1], with normal human skin and their own ears. NO green skin, NO ogre ears, NO round ogre body, NO brown vest and NO cream tunic unless [Image 1] shows them. The face is large in the close-ups: exactly the face from [Image 1], the same real person from the first frame to the last, so their friends recognize them at once. Never morph, never drift back to the ogre's face. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the one who celebrates is that animal upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings.

The moves, matching the reference second by second:
0-1.5 s: on the touchline, one hand raised to the forehead in a salute.
1.5-3 s: cups both hands behind the ears with the cheeks puffed out, the camera looks up from below.
3-4.5 s: looks up at the roaring stands.
4.5-6.6 s: cups the ears again and turns to face the camera.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on their own shoulders. Each hand has five fingers; the hands cup behind the ears and never merge with the ears, the hair or the face. The few players far in the background are new adults in plain kits, small and out of focus. No names or numbers on the shirts, no badges, no crests, no sponsor names, no score graphics, no text, no logos, no watermark.
